subject.title: Hermes importer misses current state and provider contracts

question: Should the protected Hermes migration bug be sponsored now as one coordinated importer-plus-packaged-discovery repair?
rationale: The defect is reproducible and aligned with setup reliability, but its maintainer label requires explicit ownership and the repair crosses the Hermes plugin and generic persisted-registry boundary.

options.title: Sponsor coordinated repair
options.body: Fix the Hermes importer contracts and the stale bundled-provider discovery path together with packaged fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Split registry follow-up
options.body: Repair importer fidelity first and track generic stale-registry discovery separately, accepting that packaged migration remains partially blocked meanwhile.

options.title: Defer protected work
options.body: Keep the issue open under the maintainer label until an owner can validate the pinned Hermes dependency contracts and packaged flow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor coordinated repair
recommendation.body: Fix the Hermes importer contracts and the stale bundled-provider discovery path together with packaged fresh-install and upgrade proof.
